prompts.prompt: Some divers devote years of their lives to reaching depths no human has ever reached before. They train their bodies, refine their techniques, study the limits of pressure and breath, and repeat countless small procedures until precision becomes instinct. Every record represents an encounter between extraordinary human preparation and an environment that cannot forgive certain mistakes. Beneath the surface, the familiar world disappears, and the diver continues downward into darkness, pressure, silence, and the unknown. Some record-breaking attempts end in triumph, while others end in the deaths of exceptionally skilled people who understood the risks and nevertheless pursued the limits of human experience. Their ambition is not to die, but to experience life beyond what once seemed possible, and to return alive from the edge of that possibility.
